item.tib: shes rab smra seng phyag bzhes rtsi bcud snying po'i rgyun bzang
item.coloph: ces shes rab lha mchog smra ba'i seng ge'i gzhung ma rig mun sel gyi phyag tu bzhes thabs rtsi bcud snying po rgyun bzang zhes bya ba 'di yang / rje rin po che sku mdun bsod nams blo gros dbang gi rgyal po de nyid kyi/ rang re'i mdzad pa'i sgrub gzhung 'di la phyag tu bzhes pa'i gsal byed zhig dgos pa'i bka' gsung ldog med du gnang bzhin/ phran shes rab lha sgrub la shin tu blo rtse gcig tu dril ba'i/ sde dge'i mnga' ris kyi sprang 'khyams pa/ skam btsun drung mu nyi wer bdag gis sa rta zla ba bzhi pa'i yar tshes kyi gshen bstan sman ri dgon gyi smra seng bsgrub pa'i skabs su sbyar ba rten 'brel bla med du gyur cig/
